 The film will land on Tiger TV which is a part of Lionsgate Play A poster from Arshad Warsi and Sanjeeda Shaikh starrer Jeevan Ya Bheema Con? Cinema Express Desk Updated on :  20 Nov 2026, 12:39 pm 
 Copied 
 Arshad Warsi and Sanjeeda Shaikh starrer crime-comedy Jeevan Ya Bheema Con? has gotten an OTT release date. The film will land on Tiger TV which is a part of Lionsgate Play on November 27.
 Directed by Abhishek Dogra, Jeevan Ya Bheema Con? released in theatres on September and couldn’t attract much audiences . The film also features Vijay Raaz, Pooja Chopra, Bijendra Kala and the late Atul Parchure.
 The story follows Jeevan ( Arshad ), a debt-ridden common man whose life takes an unexpected turn when he crosses paths with his dangerous lookalike, Bheema. What initially appears to be an opportunity soon spirals into a chaotic chain of events, drawing its characters into a web of lies, greed and increasingly risky choices.
 At the time of its theatrical release, the film wasn’t able to impress critics too. CE’s Review of the film read: “This desperate struggle to bring out laughter reflects in the excess of toilet comedy at use, among other elements. The quantity of fart jokes and moments playing on scatological comedy feels like an overdose.”
